Contract AirportSystem::createDevice(id: Integer,name: String,location: String,contactsid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		dev: Device = Device.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		staff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = contactsid)
	precondition:
		dev.oclIsUndefined() = true or
		staff.oclIsUndefined() = true
	postcondition:
		let newDev: Device in
		newDev.oclIsNew() and
		Device.allInstance()->includes(newDev) and
		newDev.Id = id and
		newDev.Name = name and
		newDev.Location = location and
		newDev.Contacts = staff and
		dev<>null or
		(dev = null and
		newDev.oclIsNew()) and
		result = true or
		(dev<>null and
		staff<>null and
		result = true)
}
